agent_notes: The 70 days of Egyptian mourning (v. 3) are counted from Jacob's death and include the 40 days of embalming (Rashi, Radak: 40 for embalming + 30 for weeping), so the mourning is anchored on the death's START and the embalming runs inside it. If the 70 were read as 40 + 70 the burial would be 40 days later.

Paced at walking speed: Goshen–Atad road (≈465 km) is ≈16 days on foot against 7 by chariot; I chose walking because the company is 'very great' and includes elders and a household, with margin 3 days toward the chariot pace. Atad's location 'beyond the Jordan' is the registry's coordinates; the route via Jordan's east bank (a detour round the Dead Sea) is not modelled. Pseudo-Jonathan's Esau episode at Hebron (v. 13) is not used.

agent_notes: Duration 54 years: Jacob died when Joseph was about 56 on the Masoretic chain (anchor.joseph_birth; Jacob 130 at Gen 47:9, Joseph 39), Joseph died at 110. The two chains are consistent to within a year, which is the margin; the anchor's own ±220 years is carried by the death event.

The dwelling's computed end (Feb 1805 BCE) overlaps the last words (Jan 1805 BCE) by about five weeks, because the death is dated by age from anchor.joseph_birth and the dwelling by duration from Jacob's death; this is inside the one-year margin.

Joseph's age of 110 (v. 26) is given at his death; the last words are anchored on birth + 110 years and the death follows.
